tldr: 美 4 月 CPI 年增 3.8% 創三年高，市場將降息預期推遲到 2027 年；費半 -3.01%、高通崩跌 11.46%、台積 ADR -1.79%，台股盤前承壓。
台積電「雙利多」：首季股利調升至每股 7 元（共 1,815 億元、255 萬名股東受惠），同時對美國子公司增資不逾 200 億美元，全球 capex 故事再升級。
統一主動式 ETF 00403A 掛牌寫下募集 791.7 億、首日規模 1,177 億、單日成交 420 萬張三項紀錄；公司罕見發布溢價警語，財管商品從被動指數轉向主動策略的拐點顯現。
4 月全國稅收 1,895 億元（+23%）、證交稅單月 546 億元（年增 2.1 倍、史上新高）；證交稅成為今年總稅收成長最大支柱。
金管會重罰台中商銀 3,200 萬元 AML 缺失、預告擴大金融控股集團審查；北區國稅局提醒新臺新租稅協定 2027 年生效（股利/權利金降至 10%），保單變更要保人即視為贈與。

items.title_zh: 台積電 Q1 配息調升至 7 元創新高 255 萬股東受惠
items.title_en: TSMC lifts Q1 dividend to a record NT$7/share — NT$181.5 bn payout to 2.55 mn shareholders
items.summary_zh: 台積電董事會核准首季每股配息 7 元（較前季 6 元增 16.7%），共發放 1,815.26 億元現金；除息日 9/16、發放日 10/8。國發基金以 16.5 億股可入帳逾 115 億元，全體 255.3 萬名股東同享。法人預估今年全年現金股利可達 28 元以上，反映自由現金流穩健、AI 資本支出與股東回饋雙軌並進。
items.summary_en: TSMC's board approved a Q1 cash dividend of NT$7/share, +16.7% from the prior NT$6, setting a new quarterly-dividend high. Ex-dividend date is 9/16 and payment on 10/8. The NT$181.5 bn aggregate payout flows to 2.55 mn registered shareholders; the National Development Fund alone collects more than NT$11.5 bn on its 1.65 bn shares. Analysts now model full-year 2026 cash dividend above NT$28, reflecting robust free cash flow even as capex accelerates. The hike confirms a dual-track shareholder-return narrative alongside aggressive AI-driven capacity expansion.

items.title_zh: 暌違 26 年 聯電重返百元大關
items.title_en: UMC reclaims NT$100 after 26 years — AI demand revives mature-node cycle
items.summary_zh: 聯電 12 日漲停收 104.5 元，相隔 26 年再站上百元。AI 帶動成熟製程需求復甦，第一季 28/22 奈米製程產能利用率近 80%、7 月將調漲晶圓代工報價；法人預估 2026 年 EPS 達 4.6~4.9 元，視為結構性多頭題材。聯電也是「英特爾合作概念股」核心成員，搭配川習會時程同步受惠。
items.summary_en: UMC closed limit-up at NT$104.5 on 5/12, regaining the NT$100 mark for the first time in 26 years. The rally is fueled by AI-led mature-node recovery (28/22 nm utilization near 80% in Q1) and channel-checked foundry price hikes targeted for July. Analysts project 2026 EPS of NT$4.6–4.9, framing the move as structural rather than speculative. The breakthrough cements UMC's renewed status as a key AI-foundry beneficiary outside TSMC and reinforces the "Intel concept" basket (with Faraday, Quanta) ahead of the Trump-Xi summit.

items.title_zh: 外資減碼 台股 42K 近高情怯
items.title_en: TAIEX hits 42,253 record but foreign sellers cap gains — investors warn of "K-Pop" concentration risk
items.summary_zh: 台股 12 日盤中衝 42,253 點再創高、外資大賣壓抑尾盤、收 41,898 點，投信狂買 383.17 億元為次高紀錄。專家警告台股出現與韓股相似的「漲勢集中 AI、市值膨脹、散戶 ETF 化」三大風險；下一波觀察美 4 月 CPI、費半 -3% 隔夜壓力與 5/13–15 川習會。
items.summary_en: TAIEX intraday-touched 42,253 on 5/12 before settling at 41,898 (+108 pts); foreign investors sold heavily while domestic investment trusts bought NT$38.3 bn, the second-largest single-day buy on record. Analysts flag a Korea-style "concentration-AI / mega-cap-inflated / retail-ETF-driven" three-headed risk pattern. Near-term focus: pre-open reaction to US April CPI (3.8%), Philadelphia Semi -3% overnight, and US-China headline volatility through the 5/13–15 Trump-Xi summit.

items.title_zh: MSCI 半年調整 台股新增旺矽、小型指數新增均華等 15 檔
items.title_en: MSCI semi-annual rebalance — Walsin Lihwa added to Global Standard, 15 new names in Global Small Cap
items.summary_zh: MSCI 半年度調整公布：全球標準指數台股新增旺矽（6223），刪除亞泥、仁寶、華航等 7 檔；全球小型指數新增均華、台灣高鐵、可成等 15 檔、刪除 12 檔。5/29 盤後生效，被動 ETF 將同步調倉，新增者短線流動性放大、被刪除者承壓。
items.summary_en: MSCI's May rebalance adds Walton Microelectronics (6223) to the Global Standard Taiwan basket while deleting Asia Cement, Compal and China Airlines plus 4 others; the Global Small Cap basket adds 15 names including Junfeng, Taiwan High Speed Rail and Catcher Technology, deleting 12. Effective after 5/29 close. Passive funds will rebalance accordingly, likely lifting short-term liquidity in additions and pressuring deletions. Index-tracking AUM impact concentrates around the 5/29 print.

items.title_zh: 南亞處分南電股票 174 億元
items.title_en: Nan Ya Plastics to divest NT$17.4 bn of Nan Ya PCB shares — second wave between 5/13 and year-end
items.summary_zh: 南亞董事會通過 5/13 起至年底處分子公司南電股票 1,938.5 萬股，以南電前一日收盤 900 元估算市值約 174.47 億元，為第二波減持；處分後持股仍達 60.97%、不影響控制權，公司強調為充實營運資金與提高股票流通性。南電 4 月營收創 40 個月新高、首季獲利為 2023Q3 以來最佳，市場觀察籌碼吸納強度。
items.summary_en: Nan Ya Plastics' board approved disposing of 19.385 mn Nan Ya PCB shares (~NT$17.4 bn at NT$900 reference) between 5/13 and year-end, reducing stake from 62.92% to 60.97%. Management framed the move as funding working capital and improving share-float liquidity, not a control-of-business signal. With Nan Ya PCB's April revenue at a 40-month high and Q1 profit the best since Q3-2023, attention turns to whether the supply absorbs amid ABF substrate cycle momentum.

items.title_zh: 台積增資美國廠 200 億美元
items.title_en: TSMC double-down on US — board approves up to US$20 bn capital injection into TSMC Arizona
items.summary_zh: 台積電董事會通過總額 312.84 億美元資本預算，核准對美國子公司 TSMC Arizona 增資不超過 200 億美元，加速美國先進製程與先進封裝布局，P2 廠預計 2027 下半年量產 3 奈米。鎖定美國長期 AI 產能、配合川習會強化台美科技合作；全台設備、材料、土建相關供應鏈布局美國卡位戰升溫。
items.summary_en: Alongside the dividend hike, TSMC's board approved a US$31.3 bn capital expenditure budget and authorized up to US$20 bn additional capital for TSMC Arizona, accelerating US advanced-process and packaging build-out. P2 fab targets 3-nm volume production by H2 2027. The move locks in long-term AI capacity in the US, tightens the bond with Washington ahead of the Trump-Xi summit, and reshuffles supplier opportunities across local construction, equipment and material vendors entering the Arizona ecosystem.

items.title_zh: 台積電訂單飛了？特斯拉 AI6.5 晶片恐「全轉單」給英特爾
items.title_en: Tesla weighs full-shift of AI6.5 chip from TSMC to Intel — White House lobbies for US foundry wins
items.summary_zh: 特斯拉考慮將原定由台積電代工的 AI6.5 晶片全數轉單給英特爾。川普政府推動「晶片美國製造」並成為英特爾股東後，積極協助英特爾爭取大客戶；若成真，攸關台積電先進製程地位與美國晶片自主化進度。華爾街仍質疑英特爾先進製程良率與量產可靠度，台廠基板/測試/封裝供應鏈面臨重新配置風險。
items.summary_en: Reports indicate Tesla is considering moving the entire AI6.5 chip production from TSMC to Intel Foundry, driven by the Trump administration's "Chip US Manufacturing" push after becoming a major Intel shareholder. The White House is actively wooing large customers for Intel. The shift, if executed, would be a symbolic blow to TSMC's leading-edge dominance, although Wall Street remains skeptical given Intel's unresolved yield and ramp-up challenges on advanced nodes. Supply-chain reallocation risk for Taiwanese substrate, test and packaging vendors.

items.title_zh: 台積電攜應材衝先進製程 目標加速 AI 規模化
items.title_en: TSMC + Applied Materials open Silicon Valley innovation hub — co-development to accelerate AI at scale
items.summary_zh: 台積電與美商應用材料宣布在矽谷創新中心啟動深度合作，共同研發新世代半導體材料、設備與製程，聚焦 AI 與 HPC、複雜 3D 電晶體、製程整合與良率三大領域。打破過去「設備商單向供應」模式為「晶圓廠提前共研」，加速台積電先進製程；光洋科、京鼎等周邊台廠可望受惠。
items.summary_en: TSMC and Applied Materials announced a deep co-development partnership at Applied's Silicon Valley innovation center, jointly tackling next-generation semiconductor materials, equipment and process integration. Three focus areas: AI/HPC scaling, complex 3D transistors, and process integration / yield. The shift breaks the traditional "supplier-to-fab" model into "fab-pre-participates-in-R&D", which speeds up TSMC's AI-node roadmap. Taiwanese suppliers KYEC, Lextar and Kinik may benefit indirectly via the broader equipment-and-materials ecosystem.

items.title_zh: 陸推「無敵鐵金剛」掀起機器人新革命 所羅門、上銀等沾光
items.title_en: China's Unitree unveils mass-producible humanoid GD01 — Solomon and Hiwin emerge as Taiwan plays
items.summary_zh: 中國宇樹科技發表首款量產可載人機器人 GD01，重 500 公斤、人形雙足與四足切換、人民幣 390 萬元起，被視為人形機器人量產里程碑。台廠供應鏈中，所羅門提供 AI 機器視覺系統、上銀供應滾柱螺桿與減速機等關鍵零組件，將受惠人形機器人放量訂單，是今日盤面值得關注的機器人題材股。
items.summary_en: China-based Unitree Robotics unveiled its first mass-producible passenger-grade humanoid robot GD01, weighing ~500 kg, switching between bipedal and quadrupedal modes, priced from RMB 3.9 mn. The launch is viewed as a humanoid-robotics mass-production milestone. Taiwan supply-chain plays: Solomon provides AI machine-vision systems, Hiwin supplies roller screws and reducers — both expected to gain order momentum as the humanoid theme spreads through the Taiwan stock market in 2026.

items.title_zh: 記憶體供應拉警報！三星勞資談判破局 工會下周四恐發動 5 萬人大罷工
items.title_en: Samsung union plans 18-day strike from 5/21 — DRAM/NAND supply alarm for AI servers
items.summary_zh: 三星與工會 17 小時薪資談判破裂（工會要求營業利益 15% 為獎金、資方僅允 10%），工會自 5/21 起發動 18 天罷工，4.1 萬人起跳上看 5 萬人。三星為全球最大記憶體廠，恐衝擊 DRAM/NAND 供應與報價，台廠記憶體模組（華邦電、南亞科、威剛、群聯）受惠轉單與漲價，但 AI 伺服器供應鏈成本同步上揚。
items.summary_en: Samsung's 17-hour collective-bargaining session collapsed (union demands 15% of operating profit as bonus vs. company's 10%). The union has scheduled an 18-day strike starting 5/21 with 41,000+ workers participating, potentially climbing to 50,000. Given Samsung's role as the world's largest memory maker, strike risk threatens DRAM/NAND supply and pricing. Taiwanese memory-module makers (Winbond, Nanya Tech, ADATA, Phison) face order-diversion and price-hike tailwinds; downstream AI-server BOM costs rise.

items.title_zh: 賴總統：台美合作 SMR 技術
items.title_en: Taiwan-US sign SMR MOUs — Wyoming Univ. partners CCU, INER and ITRI on small modular reactors
items.summary_zh: 總統賴清德接見美國懷俄明州州長戈登，懷俄明大學與中央大學、國家原子能研究院、工研院簽署 MOU，深化小型模組化反應爐（SMR）、碳捕捉利用與封存合作。今年台美已簽多項經貿協議；對能源安全、淨零轉型及核能供應鏈相關產業帶來新題材。
items.summary_en: President Lai received Wyoming Governor Mark Gordon as the University of Wyoming signed MOUs with Taiwan's Central University, Institute of Nuclear Energy Research and ITRI to deepen Small Modular Reactor (SMR), Carbon Capture, Utilization and Storage (CCUS) collaboration. This is one of several Taiwan-US economic agreements inked this year. Implications: incremental positives for energy-security and net-zero supply chains; potential SMR-related theme plays in Taiwan equipment, materials, engineering and IPP sectors.

items.title_zh: 金管會重罰台中商銀 3,200 萬 — AML/KYC 缺失
items.title_en: FSC fines Taichung Commercial Bank NT$32 mn for AML/KYC lapses — signals stricter private-bank scrutiny
items.summary_zh: 金管會依銀行法第 129 條第 7 款及違反銀行法第 45 條之 1、洗防法規定，重罰台中商銀 3,200 萬元；缺失包括未建立妥善企業戶開戶審查機制、網銀額度控管不足、異常交易監控規範不完善。影響全體金融業 AML/KYC 作業強度，財管端應提高高資產客戶來源審查與帳戶監控警覺。
items.summary_en: The FSC imposed a NT$32 mn penalty on Taichung Commercial Bank under Banking Act Art. 129(7), Art. 45-1 and the Money Laundering Control Act. Deficiencies include inadequate corporate-account opening review, insufficient internet-banking limit controls and incomplete suspicious-transaction monitoring. The fine signals broader AML/KYC pressure on the banking sector, with direct implications for wealth-management front-office practices on high-net-worth client onboarding and source-of-funds verification.

items.title_zh: 房貸違約潮來了？全台逾放筆數暴增六成
items.title_en: Mortgage NPL count jumps 60% YoY — early-warning signal as 新青安 grace periods unwind
items.summary_zh: 內政部 2025 第 3 季全國住宅貸款逾放 2,203 筆，創近 9 季新高、季增 41%、年增 60%；高雄 408 筆居冠、新北、台北次之。違約率仍 0.08% 低檔，但筆數激增為初期警訊；新青安寬限期陸續到期，房貸壓力恐放大，銀行需提升提存與授信紀律。
items.summary_en: Ministry of Interior statistics show Q3-2025 nationwide residential-mortgage delinquency cases reached 2,203 — a 9-quarter high, +41% QoQ and +60% YoY. Kaohsiung leads with 408 cases, followed by New Taipei and Taipei. Headline delinquency rate remains low at 0.08%, but the case-count surge is an early-warning signal. As "新青安" (new youth-housing) grace periods expire from 2026 onward, mortgage stress could amplify. Banks face provisioning headwinds; LTV-monitoring discipline becomes paramount.

items.title_zh: 貸房入股一窩瘋？金管會：銀行會做好授信 5P、風控
items.title_en: FSC: banks will apply 5P discipline as housing-equity loans spill into the equity market
items.summary_zh: 台股突破 4 萬點掀全民炒股熱，理財型房貸及信貸資金回流股市。銀行局副局長王允中表示：至 2 月底消費者貸款年增 501 億元，但銀行授信均依 5P 原則評估，信貸用途多元、無法推定全數進場；金管會強調將持續監理槓桿風險。
items.summary_en: As TAIEX broke 40,000, retail traders are increasingly using housing-equity loans and signature loans to chase stocks. FSC Banking Bureau Deputy Director Wang Yun-chung confirmed consumer-loan growth of NT$50.1 bn YTD through February but emphasized banks are applying full 5P (People, Purpose, Payment, Protection, Perspective) credit checks. Signature-loan purposes are diversified and cannot be presumed all-equity-bound. The FSC will continue monitoring leverage risk in retail margins / stock-backed loans.

items.title_zh: 玉山銀行獲准升格美國達拉斯分行
items.title_en: E.Sun Bank Dallas branch upgrade approved — Taiwan banks' US presence climbs to 26
items.summary_zh: 金管會同意玉山銀行將達拉斯代表人辦事處升格為分行，海外據點達 16 處、橫跨 11 國。考量德州大型企業與臺商進駐快速擴張，有助建構北美完整金融服務平台；我國銀行在美分行總數增至 26 家，強化臺商海外金融與財富管理服務銜接。
items.summary_en: The FSC approved E.Sun Bank's upgrade of its Dallas representative office into a full branch, bringing the bank's overseas footprint to 16 sites across 11 countries. The Dallas upgrade responds to rapid Texas-corporate / Taiwanese-business expansion and complements E.Sun's North America platform. Taiwan banks' total US branch count rises to 26, reinforcing cross-border SME-banking and HNW-wealth-management bridges between Taipei and the US Southwest.

items.title_zh: 主動式台股 ETF 上路甫滿周年 00403A 掀高潮 再寫三大紀錄
items.title_en: Active ETF 00403A debut sets three records — NT$117.7 bn day-1 AUM, 4.20 mn lots, 5.57% premium
items.summary_zh: 統一投信主動式 ETF 00403A 5/12 掛牌：募集 791.7 億元、首日規模 1,176.8 億元、單日成交 420.4 萬張，三項皆寫主動式 ETF 新高，並創台股單一商品成交量天量。30 分鐘爆百萬張、最高 10.96 元、溢價逾 6%。資金來自高息 ETF 轉進、券商造市與散戶追價；公司罕見發布溢價警語，反映台灣 ETF 投資生態正從被動指數轉向主動策略。
items.summary_en: Uni-President Investment's active Taiwan-equity ETF 00403A listed 5/12 with NT$79.2 bn raised, NT$117.7 bn day-1 AUM and 4.20 mn lots traded — all active-ETF records and a single-product TAIEX volume high. Within 30 minutes of open, 1 mn+ lots traded; intraday high NT$10.96 with premium exceeding 6%. Uni-President issued a rare overvaluation alert. Capital sources: rotation from high-dividend ETFs, market-making by brokers, and retail chasing. The move signals Taiwan's wealth-product menu pivoting from passive indexing toward active strategies.

items.title_zh: 保單要保人變更子女應申報贈與稅
items.title_en: NTBNA: switching policyholder to children triggers gift tax — file within 30 days
items.summary_zh: 父母將保單要保人變更為子女屬「無償移轉保單價值」之贈與，以變更日保單價值準備金為贈與標的，原要保人應於變更後 30 日內申報。可扣除每年 244 萬元免稅額；未申報補稅加罰，主動補報補繳免罰。為財富傳承高頻使用工具，務必同步搭配保單檢視與贈與稅試算。
items.summary_en: North-District NTB reminds that changing a life-insurance contract's policyholder from parent to child constitutes a free transfer of policy-value reserves and is a gift-tax event, measured at the policy-value-reserve on the change date. The original policyholder must file within 30 days. The annual gift-tax exemption is NT$2.44 mn. Voluntary correction before audit/notice avoids penalty. Critical practice point for wealth-management succession workflows — pair with policy-value review and gift-tax simulation before execution.

items.title_zh: 韓股今年飆漲 85% 掀資金大遷徙！民眾棄保險、定存轉戰股市 壽險解約金飆近 5 兆韓元
items.title_en: Korea Lesson — KOSPI +85% YTD triggers KRW 4.9 tn life-insurance surrender wave
items.summary_zh: 韓國股市今年漲幅 85%，吸引民眾大量解約保險、提領定存投入股市；三大壽險巨頭 Q1 解約金 4.9 兆韓元（+16.3%）、儲蓄型保單解約激增 23.2%；五大銀行定存兩個多月內縮減 12 兆韓元。金融業分化：壽險獲利下滑、證券獲利暴增。為台灣家庭資產配置與財管商品線可借鏡的場景。
items.summary_en: Korea's stock market is up 85% YTD, fueling a mass migration from insurance and deposits into equities. Top-3 Korean life insurers' Q1 surrenders hit KRW 4.9 tn (+16.3% YoY); savings-policy surrender surged +23.2%; the top-5 banks' deposits shrunk KRW 12 tn in just over two months. Industry-wide split: life-insurance profit falls, brokerage profit surges. The dynamic is a relevant scenario for Taiwan high-net-worth and mass-affluent asset-allocation conversations as TAIEX nears 42,000.

items.title_zh: 預告放寬保險業跨領域經理人聘任範圍
items.title_en: FSC pre-announces expanded cross-domain talent rule for insurance executives
items.summary_zh: 現行專業領域改採概括授權方式，除保留資訊、科技、法律、電子商務、數位經濟、財會、人資外，新增「醫療、投資、行銷、不動產、永續經濟」等領域；保險業副總、協理、經理可廣納跨界專才以提升競爭力。預告期 60 日；對保險業 ESG/醫療/不動產/數位財管等新興業務佈局實質助益。
items.summary_en: The FSC pre-announces an amendment to "Insurance Company Director / Officer Qualification Rules" replacing the current closed list (IT, finance, law, e-commerce, digital economy, accounting, HR) with a broader "general-authorization" framework, adding medical, investment, marketing, real estate and sustainable-economy domains. 60-day comment period. Implication: insurers can recruit broader cross-domain talent — useful for ESG, healthcare wealth, real-asset and digital-wealth product roadmaps.

items.title_zh: 台股 4 月交易熱 證交稅創高每天進帳 27 億 躍總稅收成長大支柱
items.title_en: April national tax revenue NT$189.5 bn (+23% YoY) — securities transaction tax NT$54.6 bn is a single-month record
items.summary_zh: 財政部公布 4 月全國總稅收 1,895 億元、年增 23%，創史上最強 4 月；1–4 月累計 8,450 億元、年增 19.3%，達分配預算 113.7%、全年預算 21.4%。證交稅單月實徵 546 億元（年增 368 億、增幅 2.1 倍），日均 27 億並連九紅；台股日均量首度破兆達 1.14 兆，證交稅成總稅收成長最大支柱，亦凸顯稅收依賴股市波動的結構性風險。
items.summary_en: MOF reports April 2026 national tax collected at NT$189.5 bn (+23.0% YoY); 4-month cumulative NT$845 bn (+19.3% YoY), reaching 113.7% of pro-rata budget and 21.4% of full-year budget. Securities transaction tax alone collected NT$54.6 bn in a single month (a NT$36.8 bn / +2.1x YoY surge, ninth consecutive monthly increase) on TAIEX daily turnover above NT$1 tn. Securities tax has now become the largest growth pillar of the 2026 fiscal program, also exposing fiscal dependence on equity-market volatility.

items.title_zh: 臺新租稅協定新約三大變動
items.title_en: NTBNA: new Taiwan-Singapore tax treaty effective 2027/1/1 — three key changes
items.summary_zh: 臺星新約於 2026/2/13 生效、自 2027/1/1 起適用。三大變動：(1) 股利、權利金、利息上限稅率統一降至 10%（原最高 40%/15%）；(2) 建築工程常設機構門檻由「1 年內逾 6 月」改為「持續逾 9 月」並新增「服務常設機構」；(3) 間接稅額扣抵、視同已納稅額扣抵僅適用至 118 年度、119 年起停止。對臺星跨境投資、控股架構與信託架構規劃影響顯著。
items.summary_en: The revised Taiwan-Singapore tax treaty entered force on 2026/2/13 and applies from 2027/1/1. Three key changes: (1) Unified 10% cap on dividends/royalties/interest (vs. previous 40%/15% maximum); (2) Construction-PE threshold lifted from "6 months within 1 year" to "continuous 9 months", with new service-PE concept added; (3) Indirect tax credit and deemed-paid credit only available through tax year 2029 — discontinued from 2030. Material implications for cross-border investment, holding-company architecture and trust structures involving Singapore.

items.title_zh: 生前訂約售不動產未過戶仍列遺產
items.title_en: NTBCA: pre-death real-estate sales without title transfer still part of the estate
items.summary_zh: 被繼承人生前訂約出售不動產但死亡時尚未完成移轉登記，仍屬遺產；應以死亡年度公告現值/評定標準價格申報，已收訂金外的未收價款應列為債權、買賣相關債務可作未償債務扣除。實例：賣價 1 億、評定價 3,500 萬，繼承人申報遺產 3,500 萬、扣同額債務、列債權 9,000 萬。對高齡客戶不動產處分時點與遺囑/信託搭配規劃具直接影響。
items.summary_en: Central-District NTB clarifies that if a decedent signed a real-estate sale contract before death but title transfer was not completed, the property remains part of the gross estate. Reporting basis: government-assessed land/building values at the date of death. Unreceived consideration becomes an estate receivable; related contractual debts deductible as unpaid obligations. Worked example: NT$100 mn sale price, NT$35 mn assessed value, NT$90 mn outstanding consideration — net estate inclusion structurally lower than headline sale price. Critical input for senior-client real-estate planning and trust/will sequencing.

items.title_zh: 大陸來源所得應併同綜所稅申報
items.title_en: NTBT: China-source income must be filed with personal Taiwan income tax
items.summary_zh: 境內居住個人取得大陸來源所得應併入綜所稅申報；大陸已繳稅可扣抵但以該所得增加之應納稅額為上限。未能提示成本費用證明者，按不動產實際成交價 12% 計算所得額。漏報需補稅加罰，未經檢舉前自動補報依法免罰。對兩岸資產配置、不動產處分客戶之申報合規甚為關鍵。
items.summary_en: Taipei NTB reminds Taiwan-resident individuals that China-source income must be aggregated into the Taiwan personal income tax return. Mainland-paid taxes are creditable, capped at the incremental Taiwan tax attributable to the China-source income. Without cost-substantiation, taxable income is presumed at 12% of real-estate gross sale proceeds. Voluntary correction prior to audit/notice avoids penalty. Important compliance input for cross-Strait wealth-allocation clients with mainland property dispositions or operating income.

items.title_zh: 美 4 月 CPI 升幅年增 3.8% 三年高點 Fed 降息機率愈來愈小
items.title_en: US April CPI 3.8% — three-year high, Fed cut bets pushed to 2027+
items.summary_zh: 美 4 月 CPI 年增 3.8% 創 2023-2024 新高；核心 CPI 年增 2.8%、月增 0.4% 雙雙超預期；汽油較去年暴增 28.4%、能源向非能源項目擴散。市場押注 Fed 最快在 2027 年 4 月前重啟升息（機率 70%）、30 年期殖利率逼近 5%；長期高利率延續、風險資產估值與台股權值股、新台幣匯價同步承壓。市場對 6/2026 降息僅給予 2.4% 機率。
items.summary_en: US April CPI rose 3.8% YoY, a 2023-2024 high; core CPI 2.8% YoY and +0.4% MoM, both beating consensus. Gasoline surged 28.4% YoY, energy-driven price pressure widening into services (notably airfares). Traders now price 70% odds of an actual Fed rate-hike by April 2027 rather than cuts. 30-year Treasury yield approaches 5%; Treasury auctions hit highest cost since Feb 2025. Implications: tighter-for-longer rate regime, headwinds for risk-asset valuations, USD/NTD policy room narrows. Markets price 6/2026 cut odds at just 2.4%.

items.title_zh: 川普透露將和習近平談對台軍售 卓揆：在互信基礎上推進合作
items.title_en: Trump signals he will raise Taiwan arms sales directly with Xi at 5/14 summit
items.summary_zh: 川普表態將在 5/14 川習會中與習近平討論對台軍售議題，可能違反雷根「六項保證」之不事先徵詢中國的慣例。卓揆強調台美關係深化、美方多次重申不容片面改變台海現狀。經濟學者警示中方可能祭出關鍵礦產施壓，造成軍售寒蟬效應。對國防供應鏈、台美關係與短線匯市、台股政治風險溢價皆有重大影響。
items.summary_en: Trump said he plans to discuss US arms sales to Taiwan with Xi Jinping at the 5/14 summit, a potential breach of Reagan's "Six Assurances" (which prohibit prior consultation with China). Premier Cho stresses deepening US-Taiwan ties and emphasizes Washington's repeated assurances against unilateral changes to the Taiwan Strait status quo. Economists warn China may leverage critical-minerals pressure, creating a chilling effect on the arms-sale program. Implications: defense-supply-chain volatility, US-Taiwan relationship recalibration, and FX/equity political-risk premium.

items.title_zh: 通膨走錯路！古爾斯比憂服務業物價失控 盛讚鮑爾是「名人堂級」Fed 主席
items.title_en: Chicago Fed's Goolsbee: inflation "going in the wrong direction" — services prices losing control
items.summary_zh: 芝加哥 Fed 總裁古爾斯比示警通膨「正朝錯誤方向發展」，服務業物價回升令人憂心、經濟可能已過熱、Fed 需採取行動；通膨已連續 5 年高於 2% 目標、非能源服務業通膨擴散。古爾斯比並盛讚鮑爾為「名人堂級」主席，為新任 Fed 主席華許上任埋下複雜的政策背景與市場期待。
items.summary_en: Chicago Fed President Goolsbee warned inflation is "moving in the wrong direction", with services prices accelerating raising fears the economy is overheating and the Fed needs to act. Inflation has now stayed above the 2% target for five consecutive years; non-energy-services inflation rebound shows price pressure has broadened from goods to services. Goolsbee praised outgoing Chair Powell as a "Hall of Fame-tier" Fed Chair — setting up a complex policy backdrop for incoming Chair Warsh.

items.title_zh: 美股收盤／晶片飆股全跌壓垮美股 通膨高油價漲讓降息希望全滅
items.title_en: US stocks tumble — Philadelphia Semi -3.01%, Qualcomm -11.46%, TSMC ADR -1.79%
items.summary_zh: 標普 500 跌 0.16%、那指跌 0.71%、費半重摔 3.01%、道瓊靠防禦類股險守紅盤。高通暴跌 11.46%（蘋果訂單損失）、英特爾 -6.82%、美光 -3.61%；台積電 ADR 跌 1.79% 至 397.28 美元、日月光 ADR 跌 2.89%、聯電 ADR 逆勢漲 3.01%。布蘭特原油升破 107、西德州破 102 美元，年內降息預期破滅、升息風險浮現；台股盤前 AI 權值股承壓、聯電可望逆勢。
items.summary_en: All three major US indices fell on 5/12 as hot CPI plus Middle East tension hammered chip leaders. Dow +0.11% (saved by defensives), S&P -0.16%, Nasdaq -0.71%; Philadelphia Semi -3.01%. Qualcomm collapsed 11.46% on Apple-order loss; Intel -6.82%; Micron -3.61% after Monday's record high; TSMC ADR -1.79% to US$397.28; ASE ADR -2.89%; UMC ADR +3.01% standing out. WTI broke US$102, Brent above US$107 on US-Iran headlines. Cut-bets evaporate, hike-risk emerges. Setup for Taipei: heavy on AI-mega-cap, possible UMC outperformance.

items.title_zh: 高通被點名晶片股「問題兒童」股價暴跌超 11%
items.title_en: Qualcomm labelled "the problem child" of the chip rally — stock crashes 11%
items.summary_zh: 高通 5/12 暴跌逾 11% 至 210.31 美元，被科技分析師點名為「晶片漲勢中的問題兒童」。原因包括蘋果持續減少晶片採購、Android 手機需求疲弱、PC 處理器面臨輝達競爭；本益比逾 20 倍但獲利成長轉弱、估值吸引力下降、AI 資料中心業務仍屬早期。半導體族群整體承壓（英特爾 -6.82%、美光 -3.61%），輝達逆勢小漲；美通膨與中東緊張加劇避險。
items.summary_en: Qualcomm plunged over 11% on 5/12 to US$210.31, called "the problem child of the semiconductor rally" by tech analysts. Drivers: Apple's continued reduction in Qualcomm chip purchases, weak Android handset demand, and Nvidia competition pressuring PC processors. Qualcomm trades above 20x P/E with decelerating earnings, eroding valuation appeal; its AI-data-center business remains early-stage. Sector-wide: Intel -6.82%, Micron -3.61%, while Nvidia bucked the trend with a modest gain. US inflation hot + Middle East tension fueled risk-off.

items.title_zh: 美光出現罕見技術訊號 是警訊還是買點？
items.title_en: Micron flashes rare overbought RSI 85 — caution after a 705% one-year run
items.summary_zh: 美光 5/11 RSI 升至 85 進入極度超買區，5/12 一度下跌 6.84%；今年累漲 159.71%、過去一年飆升 704.76%（3 月底 311 美元拉到 5/11 高點 818 美元）。基本面：2026 年 HBM 產能售罄、2027 年大部分已預訂、AI 加速器需求驅動龐大。分析認為「最容易賺的那段可能已過去」，新進資金需評估高位進場風險，既有投資人面臨獲利了結契機。
items.summary_en: Micron's RSI hit 85 on 5/11 (extreme overbought) and the stock dropped 6.84% intraday on 5/12. YTD +159.71%; one-year +704.76% (March-end US$311 → 5/11 high US$818). Fundamentals remain robust: 2026 HBM capacity fully sold out, most 2027 already pre-booked, AI accelerator demand driving structural demand. However analysts caution "the easy money has likely been made"; new entrants must evaluate high-altitude entry risk, existing holders face profit-taking decision points.
